title: Sales event receipt v1
description: The ERP's answer to a sales event it has stored: 201 the first time, 200 with `duplicate: true` and the same `receivedAt` every time after. Both mean the event is safe in the ERP.

status.description: Where the event is in the ERP. Contract v1 stores events as `received`; turning them into ingredient usage (ERP #17) moves them on to `processed` or `failed`, which a later delivery of the same event can then report.

duplicate.description: True when the ERP already had this idempotency key: nothing was stored again.

receivedAt.description: When the ERP first stored the event.
